WE SUPPORT YOU

AuraPlayer is a place where people share, learn and grow together. No matter what your role is, we will challenge you to expand your skillset. Our atmosphere is consumed by continuous

JOB OPENINGS

Developer for Mobile/Cloud

Job Type: Part-Time/ Full Time

Experience: Entry-Level

Overview

An up & coming start up in the world of Oracle, Mobile and automation is looking for a developer that thrives on Techy challenges to join our R&D team. The position will allow the developer to be involved in all phases of the development cycle including product development, design, implementation and QA.

Requirements

– Knowledge and experience in HTML, Jquery, jquery mobile, JavaScript and Java (backend as well)

– Servers knowledge and Experience – Advantage

-Knowledge in Oracle databases, SQL and PL\SQL – Advantage

– We have both full and part-time positions available
– Suitable for students
– Most of the work can be done remotely, working from home
– Availability for a bi-weekly meeting in the Ra’anana area
– you may the opportunity to work abroad as well

Application

If you are interested in this position, please include your resume, a link to your LinkedIn profile, a link to your Facebook page, and any others you wish to share. 

APPLY NOW
QA Engineer

Job Type: Part-Time

Experience: Entry-Level

Overview

An up & coming start-up in the world of Oracle, Mobile, and automation is looking for a part-time QA Engineer to join our R&D team. 

Possible opportunities to be a part of the customer’s web applications development using our patented tool.

Requirements

-Knowledge of web technologies 

-Knowledge in test automation + tools – an advantage

-Fast learner, Open-Minded

-Can think of the whole process lifecycle (design, develop, implement, QA ….)

-Organized, with keen attention to detail

-Passion for technology and desire to learn particularly SOA / Webservices / XML

-Knowledge of Oracle DB, Oracle Forms – an advantage

-Knowledge of .Net – an advantage

 

*The Job will require you to attend a team meeting and work 1-2 days a week in Ra’Anana

Application

If you are interested in this position, please include your resume, a link to your LinkedIn profile, a link to your Facebook page, and any others you wish to share. 

APPLY NOW
Customer Relations Associate
Overview

AuraPlayer is looking for a reliable, motivated, and organized candidate for the position of Customer Relations Associate.

Learn firsthand from the CEO and sales team about how to cultivate sales opportunities and assist to manage customer relationships. It is ideal for a person with a keen eye for detail and a strong work ethic. This is a part-time, entry-level position working alongside an amazing team to help launch your career in hi-tech.

Suitable for students, working moms, or anyone who needs a flexible schedule.

Responsibilities Include

– Managing calendar for leads/customer meetings and followups

– Strengthening customer relationships via email, phone and LinkedIn

– Assist sales team to send existing materials, quotes, presentations or other data to potential customers to help them move through the sales cycle

Requirements

– Must be able to send fluent English emails to customers in the US
– Have high-level attention to detail
– Able to handle multi-tasking and high-stress environments with a calm attitude
– Strong interpersonal skills and friendly, positive attitude
– Ability to work in our Raanana office at least 4 days a week (can be from 11:00 – 15:00pm). May require 30 minutes some evenings for follow-up. 
– Based out of our Raanana office on Ahuza (not remote).

Advantages

– Versed in social media – Linkedin, Twitter

– Experience with customer success or executive assistant to the CEO

Application

If you are interested in this position, please include your resume, a link to your LinkedIn profile, a link to your Facebook page, and any others you wish to share. 

APPLY NOW

David Buch
Senior Products Manager

David, our Senior Products Manager, is a highly experienced professional specializing in product definition, innovations, and development, with broad customer understanding, and skillful people management. He has over 20 years of R&D work experience, and continues to excel in his expertise. When he is not working, David enjoys spending his time as a professional tuba player joining symphony orchestras and chamber ensembles.

Elizabeth Pearl
Relationship Manager

Before joining AuraPlayer, Elizabeth completed a Masters degree in Education and worked as a teacher. Elizabeth’s role as Customer Relationship Manager combines both her passion for technology and her deep desire to educate  others. On a daily basis, Elizabeth takes the valuable insights she gained as a teacher and uses them to rise within the world of tech. She uses her skills of active listening, organization, preparation, and clear communication to enhance the wonderful relationships she has with both coworkers and customers.

 

Elizabeth is originally from the United States but currently resides in England. In her spare time, she loves exercising, spending time with her family and friends, and playing volleyball.

Nathalie Wasserman
CFO & Operations Manager

Natalie is proud to be AuraPlayer’s Operations and Chief Financial Officer. She takes pride in her work, and loves being a part of the AuraPlayer family. Prior to working at AuraPlayer, Nathalie worked at various companies as an accountant. She attended the University College London (UCL), where she graduated with a Bachelor’s Degree in economics and business. She then went on to pursue a Master’s degree in Political Economies in Eastern Europe. 

Gwen Edwards
VP Business Development

An expert in helping businesses seize their potential and grow, Gwen is committed to take AuraPlayer to the next level. With over 30 years of experience in the high technology sector and working with Fortune 500 companies, she works as an advisor for growing businesses to help enhance their value and reach their business objectives. She’s a dynamic member of our team, leveraging her sales and marketing, and P&L experience to our current and future product suite.

Gwen also serves on a several private company boards in Silicon Valley, and is an active member of the angel investment network, Golden Seeds.

Yossi Nakash
CTO & Co-Founder

A true developer, Yossi has been developing and coding in Java / J2EE, C++, .Net, and C# for over 20 years, focusing mainly on the RD side of things. Entering the Oracle World about 10 years ago, Yossi immersed himself in the world of Oracle SOA, Weblogic, EBS and EBS Mobile, as well as the Java side of things.


Prior to joining Mia to found AuraPlayer, Yossi held the role of RD team leader at RadView and was a Java developer at Motorola.
